Live lab · prototype 1

Watch it learn to walk.

The same learner that will run on the Fire 7: a rhythm with four numbers, tuned one stride at a time by an evolution strategy, while a tiny body model learns how it tips. The terrain and body here are simulated; the learning code is the real prototype.

Pick a body and press Learn.

Falls make it uneasy; improvements make it proud. Moving the soul to the Walker starts it from the Strider's gait, scaled by leg length and weight, so it should get there in far fewer trials.
